high_level_description: The image depicts a family of seven posing together on a wooden deck overlooking the ocean during sunset. The sky is painted with hues of orange and yellow, reflecting beautifully on the water below. The family consists of two adults and five children. The adult on the left appears to be a young man wearing a black sports jersey with a white logo and the word "SPORT" printed on it. He has curly hair and is standing with his hands at his sides. Next to him is a woman holding a baby. She is dressed in a light-colored jacket, dark shorts, and a cap. She is smiling and looking towards the camera.
